papers.title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
papers.what: A wearable-health foundation model pretrained on over one trillion minutes of sensor signal from five million people, with LLM agents that search downstream predictive heads and a clinician-rated Personal Health Agent on top.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025), SSL for HAR (Yuan 2024), LLMs are Few-Shot Health Learners (Liu 2023)

papers.title: QUEST: Training Frontier Deep Research Agents with Fully Synthetic Tasks
papers.what: An open family of deep research agents (2B-35B) trained with rubric-tree synthetic tasks and RL, matching or beating closed-source agents on eight benchmarks using only 8K tasks.
papers.builds_on: Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024), Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026)

papers.title: MemForest: An Efficient Agent Memory System with Hierarchical Temporal Indexing
papers.what: A write-efficient agent memory framework whose time-ordered MemTree index replaces full-state rewrites with per-node updates, reaching 79.8% on LongMemEval-S with about 6x higher construction throughput.

papers.title: Reinforcing Few-step Generators via Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching
papers.what: A two-stage method that splits a reward-tilted KL objective into distribution matching and reward maximization, giving 4-step image generators that set state of the art on SD3 and FLUX.2.
